**Re:** Northfield Distribution Hub – Operational Start and Staffing Arrangements

Further to the board approval of 18 December 2024, I am pleased to confirm that the Company has completed the lease for the Northfield Distribution Hub and that operations will commence on 1 March 2025. The lease agreement was signed on 9 January 2025 by the Company Secretary on behalf of Harborough & Vine Supplies Ltd and by the landlord's authorised representative.

The new facility is located at Unit 4–7, Northfield Industrial Estate, Northfield Road, Kettering NN16 8JZ. The site comprises approximately 4,850 square metres of warehousing space, of which 4,200 square metres is racked storage, together with 320 square metres of office and welfare accommodation. The remaining area is given over to loading bays and vehicle manoeuvring space. The hub has been fitted with 14 loading docks, of which 10 are equipped with dock levellers, and a dedicated yard suitable for articulated vehicle turnaround.

The facility has an estimated storage capacity of 12,500 pallet positions at standard UK pallet dimensions (1,200 mm × 1,000 mm), configured across six aisles of narrow-aisle racking. The racking installation was completed on 20 December 2024, and the forklift truck fleet—comprising eight counterbalance trucks and four reach trucks—was delivered on 6 January 2025. The goods inwards and goods outwards areas are fitted with the same warehouse management system used at the Market Harborough site, and network connectivity was tested successfully on 8 January 2025.

Operational start date is confirmed as 1 March 2025. The first two weeks of March will be treated as a soft-launch period, during which the hub will handle a limited volume of inbound stock only. Full two-way operation, including outbound customer orders, will commence on 17 March 2025. This phased approach is intended to allow the warehouse team to familiarise themselves with the new layout and systems before customer-facing volumes are introduced.

**Re:** Northfield Distribution Hub – Operational Start and Staffing Arrangements

Further to the board approval of 18 December 2024, I am pleased to confirm that the Company has completed the lease for the Northfield Distribution Hub and that operations will commence on 1 March 2025. The lease agreement was signed on 9 January 2025 by the Company Secretary on behalf of Harborough & Vine Supplies Ltd and by the landlord's authorised representative.

The new facility is located at Unit 4–7, Northfield Industrial Estate, Northfield Road, Kettering NN16 8JZ. The site comprises approximately 4,850 square metres of warehousing space, of which 4,200 square metres is racked storage, together with 320 square metres of office and welfare accommodation. The remaining area is given over to loading bays and vehicle manoeuvring space. The hub has been fitted with 14 loading docks, of which 10 are equipped with dock levellers, and a dedicated yard suitable for articulated vehicle turnaround.

The facility has an estimated storage capacity of 12,500 pallet positions at standard UK pallet dimensions (1,200 mm × 1,000 mm), configured across six aisles of narrow-aisle racking. The racking installation was completed on 20 December 2024, and the forklift truck fleet—comprising eight counterbalance trucks and four reach trucks—was delivered on 6 January 2025. The goods inwards and goods outwards areas are fitted with the same warehouse management system used at the Market Harborough site, and network connectivity was tested successfully on 8 January 2025.

Operational start date is confirmed as 1 March 2025. The first two weeks of March will be treated as a soft-launch period, during which the hub will handle a limited volume of inbound stock only. Full two-way operation, including outbound customer orders, will commence on 17 March 2025. This phased approach is intended to allow the warehouse team to familiarise themselves with the new layout and systems before customer-facing volumes are introduced.

Staffing at the hub will be as follows:

- **Warehouse Supervisor:** James Okafor (transfers from Market Harborough with effect from 17 February 2025)

- All products must comply with the Food Safety Act 1990, the Food Information Regulations 2014, and any applicable sector-specific assurance schemes.
- Greenway operates under Red Tractor and LEAF Marque certification. Copies of current certificates are held on file and are renewed annually.
- Each delivery must be accompanied by a delivery note stating the product, quantity, and batch or lot number. Products must be traceable to source for a minimum of 12 months from the date of delivery.
- The Company may carry out periodic quality audits, by prior arrangement, at Greenway's production site. A physical audit is scheduled for September 2025; the date is to be confirmed by the Warehouse Supervisor.

**6.5 Delivery and Shortages**

- Risk in the goods passes to the Company upon delivery at the Company's premises.
- Shortages or damages must be notified to Greenway within 48 hours of delivery, quoting the delivery note number. Greenway shall remedy any confirmed shortage or damage by credit note or replacement delivery, at its discretion, within 5 working days.
- Title to the goods remains with Greenway until payment in full has been received.
